in_sanskrit.name: Mustaque
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the treasury
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mustaque एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Mustaque is a Hindi and Urdu name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mukta' meaning 'Lord of the treasury'. This name is a sign of wealth and prosperity. It is believed that Mustaque brings good fortune, financial success, and material abundance.
